sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-full/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 26 (check 25) and Internal Quality Checks row 26 (no internal annotation)
evidence: All five prompts open with 'Evaluate the live Colderwater playground at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP' (render/constraints/functional/visual/polish prompt.md:1), and every judge.toml declares the playwright stdio MCP server (playwright-mcp --headless --isolated). Source/memory scoring is excluded: gates say 'Use only rendered browser behavior' (render:1) / 'and the live DOM' plus 'decide it from the listed DOM facts only, not from file names, bundled library names or how the code looks' (constraints:1,5); functional:22, visual:20, polish:19 say 'do not read implementation files'; functional:11 and polish:11 require evidence 'you gathered yourself in this session'; visual:13 requires scoring 'from screenshots and the rendered page you observed yourself in this session'. First-paint guessing is excluded: render criterion requires a reload; constraints criteria require typing/pasting a word and a save/clear-storage/reload readback; functional and polish criteria are all interaction sequences (keys, mouse, Run, Save, restart_app, resize); visual:14 requires entering a ten-line draft, Run, clicking into code, watching the caret ~2s and a double-click selection before screenshots. Allowed script use is narrowly bounded in app_context.md:29. Counterexample attempts: an app whose repo source looks correct but which is dead in the browser cannot pass, since no criterion is decidable from files and judges are told not to read them; a static shell with a plausible first paint passes at most the render gate, while every scored criterion requires interaction readback. A conforming alternative (canvas editor) is not penalised: constraints criterion accepts canvas/SVG and app_context.md:31 directs screenshot reading. Wording matches the template preambles. Runtime: no configured judge run exists for v16 bytes (raw-evidence-index.json scope); v15 hosted runs (Oracle 1.0, nop 0) used byte-identical solution with the same browser-driven setup. This row is a static prompt-content check, so that gap does not undermine the verdict, but actual judge tool-use on v16 is not exercised.
